question_text: A previously healthy 32-year-old man comes to the physician because of a 2-month history of fatigue and daytime sleepiness. He works as an accountant and cannot concentrate at work anymore. He also has depressed mood and no longer takes pleasure in activities he used to enjoy, such as playing tennis with his friends. He has decreased appetite and has had a 4-kg (8.8-lb) weight loss of over the past 2 months. He does not have suicidal ideation. He is diagnosed with major depressive disorder and treatment with paroxetine is begun. The patient is at greatest risk for which of the following adverse effects?
